newsitem.title: UK: Urals Novorossiisk berth 1 to close Dec 9-24 -trad.
newsitem.headline: Urals Novorossiisk berth 1 to close Dec 9-24 -trad.

text.p: Berth number 1 at Russia's main export terminal at Novorossiisk is to close for maintenance from December 9-24, traders said on Monday.
This is the only one of the four crude loading berths at Novorossiisk which can load cargoes up to one million barrels.
Traders estimated that the maintenance will cut crude output from Novorossiisk by 25-50 percent for the maintenance period.

"The amount (reduction in crude export) depends on how many of the smaller ships they can get for the other three berths, but I think these berths run pretty much full out most of the time anyway," one lifter said.
Berths two, six and seven can load only 60,000-80,000 tonnes. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 8978
